title: One item, its own alignment
summary: align-self overrides align-items for a single flex item.
explanation: align-items sets the cross-axis alignment for every child of a flex container. align-self does the same for one child and wins over the container's setting.
Here the row is top-aligned, but the Save button alone is pushed to the bottom with align-self: flex-end. Tall and short siblings keep their own sizes.
tryThis: Remove align-self from .save: it snaps back to the top.
Change align-items on .toolbar to center and watch every item move except the one with its own rule.

children.text: A taller note sits between the buttons.
